subject: [PATCH v3 05/11] mm, swap: enable THP swapin for vswap entries

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch enables THP (Transparent Huge Pages) swapin for vswap entries by checking the backing's THP amenability under a cluster lock in __swap_cache_add_check. It rejects ZSWAP and mixed batches via -EBUSY, triggering order-fallback. The patch also updates various files to handle this new behavior.
